description: Source code for CKEDITOR's HTML parser basic writer class, providing methods to generate HTML tags, attributes, comments, and text.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.basicWriter
classes.description: A class for writing HTML content with methods to generate tags, attributes, comments, and text.

methods.name: openTag
methods.description: Writes the opening part of an HTML tag.

methods.name: openTagClose
methods.description: Writes the closing part of an opening tag, handling self-closing tags.

methods.name: attribute
methods.description: Writes an attribute for the current tag, encoding attribute values.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes arbitrary data to the output buffer.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Retrieves the generated HTML, optionally resetting the buffer.
